newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NUTRECO FLOAT RAISED BY 2.3 MLN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: NUTRECO FLOAT RAISED BY 2.3 MLN SHARES.

text.p: Rabo Securities said on Thursday that it had exercised the over-allotment granted to it and Goldman Sachs by shareholders in animal and fish foods group Nutreco, raising the secondary offering of shares by 2.27 million.

The exercise of the so-called green-shoe option granted by selling shareholders as part of the firm's stock market launch will take the total number of ordinary shares outstanding through issue and secondary placement to 17,394,900, Rabo said.
Nutreco Holding NV itself had not granted the flotation syndicate an over-allotment option, it added.
